title: Golden Cartography Capability & Semantic-Integration Proof
objective: Prove the complete MCS family across world, regional, settlement/city, dungeon/interior multi-level, tactical, isometric/deck-plan and linked campaign-atlas workflows while preserving semantic owner authority, declared fidelity/provenance, local-first blocking workflows, deterministic receipts, accessibility alternatives and permission-safe projections.

scope.purpose: Close the MCS family with a deterministic golden capability and semantic-integration proof over all completed cartography tranches without creating replacement owner-domain or generic production/interchange authority.
scope.completion_gate: The 12 surviving MCS tranches are proven together on representative original Multiversal cartography workflows with generator-to-edit continuity, large-map performance, local-first blocking workflows, deterministic receipts, accessibility alternatives, rights/provenance, honest interchange loss reporting, authorization-safe projection and explicit separation between cartographic presentation and canonical owner truth.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-16 publication. MCS.golden_proof_requires is satisfied and strict MCS order selects MCS-21.
MCS-21 is the final MCS golden capability proof and consumes MCS-01..19 plus PCA-16 as completed evidence rather than reopening their implementation scopes.
Golden proof must cover world/regional, settlement/city, dungeon/interior multi-level, tactical, isometric/deck-plan and linked campaign-atlas workflows with generator-to-manual-edit continuity.

Evidence must include vector/raster editing, custom assets, styles/templates, large-map performance, structured/flattened export, offline/local-first blocking workflows, accessibility alternatives, deterministic procedural receipts, rights/provenance, import-loss reporting, permission filtering and presentation-only versus owner-bound comparisons.
MCS-21 may not create parallel World/Scene/Settlement/Visibility/Combat/ARI/PCA/VTI/MAI authority or conceal unsupported semantics/fidelity loss.
MCS-21 is governed-started on branch work/mcs-21-golden-cartography-proof from application main f6ad609c51eff7cb59ccec35709b3ca267fe3006; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
Downstream successor selection after MCS-21 must reconsult the live DAG; no downstream family is started by this selection.
The independent ui-implementation lane is preserved unchanged.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the complete MCS golden cartography proof, then implement only bounded MCS-21 proof behavior through validation, serialized publication and closeout.
